extracted.subtask_description: Ethical guidelines for individuals evaluating submissions to the AAAI-24 conference, describing expected conduct, conflict-of-interest handling, confidentiality, and review quality standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Acknowledge responsibility to uphold ethical standards
rubrics_metrics.description: I acknowledge my responsibility to uphold ethical standards in my role.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: General affirmation of reviewer duty to follow the guidelines; no specific scoring guidance provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Be fair, unbiased, and objective; treat authors with respect
rubrics_metrics.description: I will strive to be fair, unbiased, and objective in my evaluation of submissions. I will treat all authors with respect and provide constructive feedback in a professional and courteous manner.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes impartiality, respectful tone, and actionable constructive feedback rather than ad hominem or dismissive comments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disclose conflicts of interest and decline if not qualified
rubrics_metrics.description: I will disclose any conflicts of interest that may affect my ability to provide an impartial review. If I am not qualified to review a paper or feel that my objectivity may be compromised, I will decline the invitation to review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requires proactive disclosure; declining review is appropriate when lacking expertise or objectivity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not review submissions from same institution or close collaborators
rubrics_metrics.description: I acknowledge that it is not permissible to review submissions that I suspect to be authored by authors from my own institution, or with whom I work, or have worked, closely.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicit prohibition on reviewing work from (suspected) institutional colleagues or close collaborators to avoid institutional/cooperative bias.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exclude self when aware of conflicts (prior co-authorship, close relationships)
rubrics_metrics.description: I commit to provide an impartial review of all papers. If I suspect, or am aware of, a conflict of interest which may include prior co-authorship, a close professional relationship, or a personal relationship, I will promptly inform the chairs and exclude myself from the peer-review process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies examples of conflicts (prior co-authorship, close professional or personal relationships) and requires notifying chairs and recusal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review objectively without personal criticism and offer improvement suggestions
rubrics_metrics.description: I commit to review all papers objectively and without personal criticism of the author. I will also strive to offer suggestions for improvement that will enhance the quality of the paper and to provide supporting arguments to my review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Encourages constructive, evidence-based critique and actionable suggestions rather than personal attacks or unsupported assertions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Evaluate solely on academic merit (no bias from personal characteristics)
rubrics_metrics.description: I will evaluate papers solely on their academic merit, without regard to the authors’ personal characteristics, affiliations, or backgrounds.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prohibits discrimination or favoritism based on authors' identity, institution, or background; focus reviews on scientific/technical content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maintain confidentiality of the review process
rubrics_metrics.description: I will maintain the confidentiality of the review process and respect the privacy of the authors and all involved in the evaluation. I will not use information obtained during the review process for personal advantage or disclose it to unauthorized individuals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes prohibition on sharing manuscripts, review contents, or using privileged information (e.g., results, ideas) for personal gain.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check submissions for plagiarism and report suspicions
rubrics_metrics.description: I will carefully check the submissions for any indications of plagiarism, and if any such instances are suspected, I will inform the chairs immediately. I understand that plagiarism is a serious ethical violation and will take all necessary steps to ensure that the papers I review are original and make proper use of citations and quotes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requires vigilance for plagiarism and immediate reporting to chairs; reviewers should consider citation practices and originality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adhere to chairs' guidelines and deadlines; provide timely, thorough feedback
rubrics_metrics.description: I will adhere to the guidelines and deadlines set forth by AAAI-24 Chairs and provide timely and thorough feedback to the authors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stresses meeting program deadlines and providing sufficiently detailed reviews to help authors and program chairs; timeliness and thoroughness are explicit expectations.
